fato_historico: 1975: East Timor: Governor Mário Lemos Pires of Portuguese Timor abandons the capital Dili, following a coup by the Timorese Democratic Union (UDT) and the outbreak of civil war between UDT and Fretilin.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a shifting tide, much like the winds of change that once swept across distant islands. Consider how you handle transitions in your own life. It is a good time to release old structures that no longer serve your unique path. Perhaps focus on building bridges instead of walls, finding harmony even amidst unexpected social turbulence.
frase_do_dia: True freedom is found in the courage to evolve with a grace-filled heart.
significado_numero: A powerful master number representing intuition and spiritual awakening for your soul.
conselho: Trust your inner compass and remain open to spontaneous shifts in your daily routine.
